subject: Cluster standard errors when SEM has categorical items

messages.author: e5c4db1a1cffab6b
messages.subject: Cluster standard errors when SEM has categorical items
parts:
Dear all,

I am estimating a factor model with categorical items and I would like to cluster the standard errors at the Village level. I am getting the following error which is unfortunately not very informative. Has anybody encountered a similar challange?

sem_2pm <- sem(model, data=data.pf, std.lv=F,
                cluster = "village", estimator="dwls",
               optim.method ="GN")
lavaan ERROR: invalid value for 'se' argument when estimator is DWLS: robust.cluster

Thanks

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Cluster standard errors when SEM has categorical items
parts: lavaan ERROR: invalid value for 'se' argument when estimator is DWLS: robust.cluster

You didn't set the se= argument explicitly, but it is implied by requesting cluster-robust SEs when using the cluster= argument with a single-level model syntax.  These are currently only available with ML estimation.
